findings.problem: With no hint, the bare prompt 'calm' also allows calmado, a common Latin American adjective, so the learner cannot tell which word is wanted.
findings.fix: hint: the everyday word, also said on its own to mean 'Relax!'

back.example: (Stay) calm, everything is going to be fine.

note: The example uses the feminine form tranquila said on its own as a reassurance, which is natural and fine, but the editor may want to note that it shows the feminine form, not es.
